## Description

**What**: Update CLAUDE.md (Quick Reference table, Architecture section) and other plugin documentation that describes the four-skill project-setup workflow. Replace references with the consolidated /dso:onboarding entry point. Update plugins/dso/docs/MIGRATION-TO-PLUGIN.md if it describes the four-skill workflow. Style and structure per .claude/docs/DOCUMENTATION-GUIDE.md.

**Why**: User-facing documentation must reflect the new single-entry-point workflow so future agents and contributors have accurate awareness. This is the documentation update story per the skill's documentation-update-story requirement.

**Scope**:
- IN: CLAUDE.md Quick Reference table updated to show /dso:onboarding as the single project-setup entry; CLAUDE.md Architecture section updated to describe phases/ + prompts/ structure. plugins/dso/docs/MIGRATION-TO-PLUGIN.md updated where it describes the deleted skills. KNOWN-ISSUES updated only if a real known issue exists (not speculative).
- OUT: New documentation files (style guide says update existing only). Cross-reference grep cleanup (S5 covers raw skill-name references; S8 covers user-facing prose updates).

## Done Definitions

- When this story is complete, CLAUDE.md Quick Reference table reflects /dso:onboarding as the single project-setup entry point (no rows referencing /dso:init, /dso:architect-foundation, or /dso:generate-claude-md remain)
  ← Satisfies: documentation update for skill consolidation
- When this story is complete, project documentation accurately describes the new phases/ + prompts/ structure for future agents and contributors
  ← Satisfies: documentation update for new architecture

## Considerations

- [Maintainability] Style and structure per .claude/docs/DOCUMENTATION-GUIDE.md — do not introduce new documentation patterns or files; update existing docs only.

## Escalation Policy

**Escalation policy**: Proceed unless a significant assumption is required to continue — one that could send the implementation in the wrong direction. Escalate only when genuinely blocked without a reasonable inference. Document all assumptions made without escalating.
data.title: Update CLAUDE.md and plugin docs to reflect consolidated /dso:onboarding
